[head=1]Server Rules[/head]
[head=2]Rule 1: Community Conduct[/head]
1.1 - This is an 18+ Community. In accepting these rules you affirm that you are at least 18 years of age, and understand that dishonesty in this matter will be met with a permanent ban.
1.2 Treat all members with respect and courtesy. Toxicity, harassment, and impersonation of others are explicitly forbidden, along with bigoted content and offensive language.
1.3 - Promotion or distribution of illegal and illicit content in our community is forbidden.
1.4 - Do not share information out of character that is not already common knowledge. While discussion and coordination of character storylines is permitted, sharing secret information via out of character channels (e.g., reporting antag activity before it is discovered by others) is not allowed. Furthermore, any information shared must not be acted upon in-character without learning it through IC means (see rule 2.7).
[head=2]Rule 2: Roleplay[/head]
2.1 - Erotic Roleplay (ERP) is prohibited. While this is an 18+ community and discussion of mature topics is permitted, actual sexual activity in-game is not acceptable.
2.2 - This is a High Roleplay (HRP) server that aims to form a long-term storytelling environment. The goal is collaborative storytelling, not "winning".
2.3 - Characters must be appropriate, and fit the setting through names, common sense (do not actively seek out pain or death) outside of proper roleplay circumstances, should not be needlessly suicidal, should seek comfort and care. Generally, make efforts to eat quality food, engage with the people around them, and be an actual person.
2.4 - While in-character prejudice and "speciesism" is permitted, prejudice towards real-world groups are not. Attempts to use in-universe bigotry as a cover for real-world prejudice will be treated harshly.
2.5 - Roleplay cannot be used an excuse to needlessly murder or grief. Your character must have reason to attack or kill another individual personally.
2.6 - You must escalate when attacking another individual, making your intent clear (such as aiming your weapon at them, or ordering them to halt in pursuit) and giving them a chance to respond (them unholstering their weapon, or them continuing to flee). Special circumstances may warrant reduced escalation, such as political assassinations. Request permission from staff prior to obtain this.
2.7 - Use of metaknowledge that your character would not have access to is forbidden (unless it is "general" knowledge from events after 48 hours). This knowledge can include being a wayfinder around a place they've never been, using event knowledge that was released OOCly but not ICly, or other knowledge that they would have no access to having been shared.
